title: Verify the host payload once per ia host apply
summary: ia host --apply shares one verification of the host payload (about 1,400 files) between its MCP plan and its projection pre-check, so an apply scans the payload fewer times. Each step that writes still verifies afresh, so a payload that changes during the command still refuses the apply. In @inventarch/distribution, planHost, planHookRegistration and materializeHostPayload take an optional verify parameter for that shared verification: only a verifier from hostVerifier (./host-observe) is shared, and any other function is ignored in favour of a fresh check.
